title: HomeOps Repository Inventory
description: Schema for .inventory/repos.yaml — describes Git repositories managed by this home lab.

name.description: Short human-readable name for this repository.

url.description: Clone URL. Use HTTPS or SSH format. Do not commit tokens in the URL.

description.description: What this repository contains or manages.

deploy_host.description: Name of the node (from nodes.yaml) where this repo is checked out or deployed.

deploy_path.description: Filesystem path on deploy_host where the repo lives.

local_checkout_path.description: Path on the control workstation where this repository is checked out, if present locally.

deploy_strategy.description: How this repository is deployed or consumed operationally.

deployed_services.description: Service ids from services.yaml that are built from or deployed by this repository.

update_trigger.description: How changes in this repository become deployed runtime changes.

auto_deploy.description: Whether commits or pushes can trigger deployment automatically.

branch.description: Branch that the deployment automation watches.

workflow.description: Workflow or pipeline name responsible for deployment.

runner_node.description: Node id from nodes.yaml that hosts the runner or performs the deploy.

notes.description: Free-form notes about the deployment flow.

depends_on_repos.description: Other repositories this repo depends on operationally or in its deployment flow.

auto_pull.description: Whether a cron job or systemd timer automatically pulls updates.

branch.description: Default branch tracked on this host.
